_doc: Hand-audited migration record for the Phase 0 ontology-seam revert (commit 9f186fa, 'fix(versum): revert claims.csv companion-row design'). Lists every claims.csv row commit e539c15 ('fix(versum): agree claims.csv with the audit; join source-scoped nD axes onto entries') miswrote for tests/fixtures/credit_case/policy.txt when indexed with the law-eu profile, and the rationale for treating each as miswritten rather than legitimate. Derived by: `git archive e539c15` into a SCRATCHPAD export (never a worktree), indexing tests/fixtures/credit_case there with `versum index --profile law-eu`, and comparing that claims.csv against the source sentences and against the current (post-revert) HEAD's claims.csv for the same fixture/profile.
method: git archive e539c15 | tar -x into the scratchpad phase0 dir; `versum index <export>/tests/fixtures/credit_case-derived src --profile law-eu --out out` there via PYTHONPATH=<export>/src; read out/claims.csv; for every row absent from the current HEAD's claims.csv for the same fixture/profile, hand-audit its predicate/type/verification against the source sentence it claims to cover.

miswritten_rows.source_sentence: The controller must not make a solely automated decision on a credit application.
miswritten_rows.rationale: This row restates the norm's regulated action ('make a solely automated decision on a credit application') as a SECOND claims.csv row, under verification='structural' -- a value outside the asserted provenance vocabulary (candidate/confirmed/attested) claims.csv requires. The action is normative content (part of what the F operator forbids), never itself a directly-observed candidate claim off the source text with its own asserted provenance chain. Per the Phase 0 write boundary (docs/architecture/planes.md, versum.store.graph.ClaimProvenanceError), a norm's action type/content must never be written to claims.csv under any verification or column shape; it belongs only in the entry model (entries.csv/entry_claims.jsonl) as an unasserted action-type entry linked from the norm's own entry by the structural 'embeds' relation. Miswritten: yes.

miswritten_rows.source_sentence: A reviewer shall examine every rejection before it is sent.
miswritten_rows.rationale: Same defect as action-132c3e5a91: a second claims.csv row ('examine every rejection') asserting the obligation's regulated action, stamped verification='structural' (not an asserted provenance chain), linked back only by a claims.csv-local 'embedded_in' column that no longer exists post-revert. Miswritten: yes -- the action lives only in the entry model now.

miswritten_rows.source_sentence: The controller may use the score to prepare a decision.
miswritten_rows.rationale: Same defect again: the permission's regulated action ('use the score to prepare a decision') asserted as its own claims.csv row with a non-asserted verification. Miswritten: yes.

rows_confirmed_not_miswritten.source_sentence: The controller must not make a solely automated decision on a credit application.
rows_confirmed_not_miswritten.rationale: The normative (operator) claim's own row: verification='candidate' (asserted vocabulary), source_urn + span present, dimension empty (matches Profile.projections_5d()'s 'not_declared' verdict for an unmapped predicate). Legitimate; unchanged by the revert.

rows_confirmed_not_miswritten.source_sentence: A reviewer shall examine every rejection before it is sent.
The controller may use the score to prepare a decision.
